method: Visual review of all existing logo previews on cream, original alpha inspection, official website alternatives and nursery/plant photographs, or background extraction with the built-in image editing tool. Edited results were checked against the original; Edited PNG results were exported as responsive WebP assets retaining aspect ratio and alpha transparency. Photos focus on plants and nursery spaces, not people.
imageEditPrompt: Background extraction only; preserve authentic logo spelling, typography, composition, botanical/animal shapes, and foreground colors. Remove only the flat rectangular backing and empty background gaps. Genuine alpha; no redesigned branding, added text, shadow, outline, or checkerboard. Where formerly white foreground would disappear against cream, darken that foreground for legibility.
fallbackPolicy: Use original transparent branding or a verified official plant/nursery photograph when a background-dependent logo, tiny site icon, or complex artwork is unsuitable. Remove misattributed third-party directory logos rather than implying they belong to a grower.
